newsitem.title: FINLAND: Enso says has $1.5 bln credit programmes.
newsitem.headline: Enso says has $1.5 bln credit programmes.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Enso Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it signed on September 6 a long-term and a short-term debt programme for a total of $1.5 billion.
Enso said it had agreed a $1 billion Euro Medium Term Note (EMTN) multi-currency facility which replaced a $300 million programme from 1990.
"The programme is part of Enso's target to broaden its international investor base and increase its presence on international financial markets," it said.
It also announced a $500 million Euro Commercial Paper (ECP) programme which replaced another Enso-Gutzeit $300 million programme.
Enso noted that it also has a one billion markka domestic commercial paper programme.
